remarks: Welcome to Marquis West! This stunning 2,296 sqft. Hadley K offers exceptional space, style, and thoughtful design throughout. Step inside to a welcoming open-to-above foyer that creates an impressive first impression, leading into a bright and spacious main floor designed for both everyday living and entertaining. The heart of the home features a generous kitchen with an oversized 9'6 island, perfect for family gatherings and hosting guests. Upstairs, the versatile bonus room provides additional living space, while the spacious primary bedroom offers a relaxing retreat with a luxurious 5-piece ensuite. A double attached garage and convenient side-entry basement add functionality and future potential. Located in the desirable Marquis West community, this beautiful new home is ready to welcome you. *Virtually staged for illustration purposes. Appliances, furniture and decor not included.* (id:67522)
